module_summary: mc_save_formats.c imports single PS2 saves from other tools' formats (Blaze MCM, MAX Drive .max with an LZARI decoder, CodeBreaker .cbs with RC4+zlib, SharkPort .sps/.xps, PS3 .psv) into McSaveData and writes .cbs; it is used by dash_card_tool.c and dash_browser.c. mc_sha256.c is a standalone SHA-256 used for card fingerprints (mc_card_view.c), save export and per-save versions, and is also compiled by many host tests. mmce_backup.c backs up and scans every MMCE card image into WLE-MMCE-Backups history folders, with fingerprint sidecars to skip unchanged cards and retention pruning. mmce_card_switch.c asks the MMCE device which card it serves (devctl plus content fingerprint of __active_card__.mcd) and switches to a numbered card. mmce_igr.c patches the embedded wle_igr helper ELF with app/backup paths and installs, removes or inspects it on MC, USB or MMCE BootCard images; mmce_save_versions.h is the API of the per-save .psu versioning in mmce_save_versions.c.

reusable_helpers.name: join_path
reusable_helpers.what: joins dir and name with '/' unless dir ends in '/' or ':', returns 0 on truncation

reusable_helpers.name: read_chunk
reusable_helpers.what: open, seek and read exactly N bytes at an offset

reusable_helpers.name: backup_stamp
reusable_helpers.what: YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS local-time stamp from the CDVD RTC (BCD) with a Timer() fallback

reusable_helpers.name: files_equal_serial
reusable_helpers.what: byte compare of two files in 64 KB chunks

reusable_helpers.name: write_verified
reusable_helpers.what: write a buffer to a file, read it back and compare, remove on mismatch

reusable_helpers.name: parent_dir
reusable_helpers.what: directory part of a device path including the trailing '/' or ':'

reusable_helpers.name: inflateAll
reusable_helpers.what: zlib inflate of a whole buffer with an optional exact expected size and a 64 MB cap

reusable_helpers.name: mmceCardUnit
reusable_helpers.what: returns 0/1 for an mmce0:/mmce1: path, else -1

findings.title: mc_sha256.c duplicates the Mbed TLS SHA-256 that is linked into the same ELF
findings.problem: The shipped wLaunchELF links both mcSha256Init/Update/Final and mbedtls_sha256_starts/update/finish (Mbed TLS is always built in: WLE_NATIVE_CLOUD and mbedcrypto are unconditional, and mc_save_export.c already includes mbedtls headers). The header's reason, builds without the TLS stack, no longer exists; the only remaining reason is that host tests compile mc_sha256.c without Mbed TLS.
findings.fix: On the target, make McSha256 a typedef of mbedtls_sha256_context and the three functions thin static inline calls to mbedtls_sha256_starts(.., 0)/update/finish in mc_sha256.h, and stop compiling src/mc_sha256.c in ps2.yaml. Host tests either link the host Mbed TLS or keep the current portable file as a test-only source under tests/.
findings.benefit: MEASURED from sizes/wLaunchELF-unstripped-all-symbols-by-size.tsv: mcSha256Update 1260 + mcSha256Final 564 + mcSha256Init 72 + iv 32 bytes, plus the 256-byte K table (INFERRED: 64 x u32) = about 2.2 KB of ELF.
findings.evidence: Read mc_sha256.c/h fully. grep mcSha256 over the repo: used by mc_card_view.c, mc_save_export.c, mmce_save_versions.c (target) and 10 host tests (test_mc_card_view.py, test_mc_save_formats.py, etc. compile src/mc_sha256.c). Symbol sizes from evidence/Launchstation/raw/sizes/wLaunchELF-unstripped-all-symbols-by-size.tsv show both mcSha256* and mbedtls_sha256_* (incl. mbedtls_internal_sha256_process 3896 B) in the shipped ELF. Brief: WLE_NATIVE_CLOUD always defined (ps2.yaml:625), mbedcrypto linked (ps2.yaml:641). INFERRED part: that the host test setup can be adjusted without keeping a second copy.

findings.title: mmce_backup.c: three copies of the MemoryCards tree walker and three copies of the history-root setup
findings.problem: process_tree and scan_tree are the same 44-line recursive walker (skip . and .., join_path, recurse on dirs, count and report progress on *.MCD, strip source_root) differing only in the leaf call and the stats type; count_candidates repeats the same loop again. mmceBackupAllCards and mmceBackupScanCards share 25 identical lines of argument checks and history_root construction (only ensure_dir_tree differs), and mmceBackupCardPath rebuilds history_root the same way.
findings.fix: Keep one walker that takes a leaf callback and a context (the counting pass becomes a callback that increments), and one static helper that validates options and builds <dest>/WLE-MMCE-Backups/mmceN; delete scan_tree and the repeated setup blocks. Update tests/test_mmce_backup.py, which slices the source text by function names.
findings.benefit: about 60 source lines net (44-line scan_tree and ~20 lines of count_candidates removed, ~22 duplicated setup lines folded, ~25 lines of new walker/helper glue); small code size gain INFERRED
findings.evidence: Read mmce_backup.c 686-1002; compared process_tree 742-786 with scan_tree 920-963 line by line (only lines 780-781 vs 958 and the stats type differ). dupes-blocks lead: 745-770 == 923-948 and 791-819 == 968-996. Callers: dash_browser.c:1524, dash_tools.c:413, :641, main.c:166, dash_browser.c:2352. tests/test_mmce_backup.py:12-57 indexes 'static int backup_one(', '\nstatic int count_candidates(', 'int mmceBackupAllCards(', 'int mmceBackupScanCards(' and asserts ensure_dir_tree is absent from the scan API, so the refactor must keep those properties.

findings.title: join_path, dir_exists and mkdir-or-exists are re-implemented in mmce_backup.c, mmce_igr.c and mmce_save_versions.c
findings.problem: join_path in mmce_igr.c:34-44 is a byte-identical copy of mmce_backup.c:73-83, and svJoin in mmce_save_versions.c:27-34 is the same logic again; svDirExists (mmce_save_versions.c:36-47) is identical to dir_exists (mmce_backup.c:85-96). mmce_igr.c open-codes 'genMkdir, else probe with genDopen' three times, which is what svMkdir and ensure_dir_tree already do.
findings.fix: Make join_path, dir_exists and a mkdir-if-missing helper non-static in one file (for example next to wleExists in main_fileops.c) and use them from all three files; delete the copies and the three inline probe blocks.
findings.benefit: about 45 source lines net (19 lines of join copies, 12 of dir_exists, ~24 of inline mkdir probes, minus ~5 lines of prototypes); negligible ELF change (static helpers, INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read all cited ranges. grep '^static int (join_path|dir_exists|ensure_dir_tree|...)' over src: definitions only in mmce_backup.c and mmce_igr.c; svJoin/svDirExists/svMkdir read at mmce_save_versions.c:27-52. tests/test_mmce_publish.py:50-57 and test_mmce_targeted_safety.py:83 supply their own join_path stubs when compiling extracted code, so moving the helper keeps those harnesses working (they may need the stub kept).

findings.title: Dead non-PS2BUILD #else branches for embedded ELF symbols in mmce_igr.c and elf.c
findings.problem: WLE_PS2BUILD is defined by the only build (ps2.yaml:615, kept by scripts/configure_ds34.py:36 for DS34); the legacy Makefile that used the plain wle_igr_elf/loader_elf names is retired. Neither file is compiled by a host test, so the #else branches can never be built.
findings.fix: Delete the #ifdef/#else/#endif and keep only the *_irx extern declarations (and in elf.c the two #define aliases, or rename the uses).
findings.benefit: about 10 source lines; no ELF change
findings.evidence: grep WLE_PS2BUILD over the repo: ps2.yaml:615, configure_ds34.py:36, elf.c:15, mmce_igr.c:16 only. grep 'mmce_igr.c|elf.c' in tests: only text reads (test_wle_igr.py:6, test_ember_launch.py:10, test_neutrino_iso.py:9), no compilation. Brief section 2: Makefile retired (docs/BUILDING.md:22).

findings.title: mmce_igr.c re-implements its own install/inspect plumbing several times
findings.problem: install_direct_helper rebuilds the target path that direct_helper_target computes, and its mc branch is install_helper_on_mc_slot for slot boot[2]-'0'; the split/pick-free-slot/filerMountVmc preamble is written out in all three BootCard functions; the 'reset count, collect_boot_images for mmce0 and mmce1' loop appears three times; the CURRENT/OUTDATED/MISSING/failed counting chain appears three times in wleIgrStatus.
findings.fix: Have install_direct_helper call install_helper_on_mc_slot for mc paths and direct_helper_target for USB; factor the mount preamble, the two-unit collect loop and the status counting into one small static function each.
findings.benefit: about 35 source lines net; small code size reduction INFERRED
findings.evidence: Read mmce_igr.c 1-804 in full and compared the cited blocks. tests/test_wle_igr.py:27 asserts 'install_helper_on_any_mc' is present in the source; that name is kept by this fix.

findings.title: Little-endian rd16/rd32/wr16/wr32 copied into five mc_*.c files, mode-bit macros into two
findings.problem: The same static byte-order helpers (17 lines in mc_save_formats.c and mc_card_write.c, 15 in mc_ps1_card.c, 11 in mc_save_export.c, 5 in mc_card_view.c) are redefined in each file, and mc_save_formats.c repeats ENT/M_EXISTS/M_DIR/M_FILE from mc_card_write.c.
findings.fix: Put the four helpers once as static inline functions (and the shared ENT/M_* card constants) in a small common header such as mc_card_write.h, which mc_save_formats.c already includes, and delete the per-file copies.
findings.justification: Adds one header block of about 17 lines but removes about 65 duplicated lines across five files; no new layer.
findings.benefit: about 48 source lines net; no ELF change (static helpers are inlined either way, INFERRED)
findings.evidence: grep '^static (uint32_t|void) (rd16|rd32|wr16|wr32)' over src: mc_card_view.c:31-32, mc_card_write.c:20-30, mc_ps1_card.c:17-27, mc_save_formats.c:26-36, mc_save_export.c:14-18; bodies read and identical (mc_ps1_card.c wr32 calls wr16 twice, same result). mc_card_write.c:10-14 defines ENT, M_EXISTS, M_DIR, M_FILE with the same values as mc_save_formats.c:11-17.

findings.title: mmce_igr.c prefix_case_equal and mmce0:/mmce1: prefix tests re-implement strncasecmp and mmceCardUnit
findings.problem: prefix_case_equal (19 lines, one caller at line 76) is strncasecmp(name, "BootCard", 8) == 0, and strncasecmp is already used in the same build (mmce_card_switch.c:68). The pair strncmp(boot, "mmce0:", 6) && strncmp(boot, "mmce1:", 6) is written three times, and mmceCardUnit already answers exactly that.
findings.fix: Delete prefix_case_equal and call strncasecmp at line 76; replace the three mmce prefix tests (and the one in portable_mmce_path) with mmceCardUnit(boot) < 0, including mmce_card_switch.h.
findings.benefit: about 20 source lines; a few dozen bytes of code INFERRED
findings.evidence: grep prefix_case_equal over repo: definition mmce_igr.c:46 and the call at :76 only (tests do not mention it). Read mmceCardUnit at mmce_card_switch.c:43-48 (accepts exactly mmce0:/mmce1:). strncasecmp used at mmce_card_switch.c:68, 72, 80, which include only launchelf.h, the same as mmce_igr.c.

findings.title: mcSaveFormatExt and mcSaveFormatName are never called
findings.problem: Neither function has a caller: the only matches for the names in the repo are the definitions and the prototypes (no src, test or script use).
findings.fix: Delete both functions and their prototypes.
findings.benefit: 28 source lines. MEASURED: --gc-sections already drops their 2 x 56 bytes of .text (raw/link/wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-all.tsv); their switch tables (2 x 24 B) and label strings stay in .rodata because the build has no -fdata-sections (INFERRED, ~150 B).
findings.evidence: Grep 'mcSaveFormatExt|mcSaveFormatName' over src/Launchstation: mc_save_formats.c:878, :891, mc_save_formats.h:61-62 only. xref/wLaunchELF-xref-candidates.tsv lists both with 0 references; gc-discarded-all.tsv lists .text.mcSaveFormatExt/.text.mcSaveFormatName; the fdata experiment additionally discards .rodata..Lswitch.table.* (24 B each).

findings.title: mc_save_formats.c nameOk duplicates the exported mcCardNameOk
findings.problem: nameOk(name, n) applies the same rule as mcCardNameOk (its own comment says so); every call passes n = 32 or 64, and since names of 32 or more bytes are rejected either way the result equals mcCardNameOk(name), which mc_card_write.h (already included) exports.
findings.fix: Delete nameOk and call mcCardNameOk(name) in startSave and addFile.
findings.benefit: 15 source lines; tens of bytes of code INFERRED
findings.evidence: Read both functions. nameOk callers: startSave (line 95) and addFile (line 119); their name_n arguments come from lines 242, 248 (32), 494, 507 (32), 610, 623 (32), 763, 781 (64), 808, 819 (32). For n >= 32 both loops stop at the first NUL or reject length 32+, and the character tests are identical (mc_card_write.c:45-52 vs mc_save_formats.c:50-56). mcCardNameOk declared at include/mc_card_write.h:61.

findings.title: mmce_backup.c: unused NULL-options defaults and a forwarding wrapper
findings.problem: All five callers of mmceBackupAllCards, mmceBackupCardPath and mmceBackupScanCards pass &options, so the three static defaults structs and 'if (options == NULL) options = &defaults' are never used. mmceCardFingerprint only forwards to the static card_fingerprint.
findings.fix: Delete the three defaults structs and NULL fallbacks (treat NULL as invalid with the existing argument check); rename card_fingerprint to mmceCardFingerprint and delete the wrapper.
findings.benefit: about 12 source lines; a few dozen bytes of .rodata/.text INFERRED
findings.evidence: Grep of the three API names outside tests: dash_browser.c:1524 and :2352, dash_tools.c:413 and :641, main.c:166, all with &options or &j->options. mmceCardFingerprint callers: mmce_card_switch.c (8 calls) and tests/dash_card_tool_host.c:425 (a host stub of its own).

findings.title: mcSaveFormatRead rewrites *format with an expression that always equals f
findings.problem: *format is already set to f at line 938, and the conditional at line 952 evaluates to f in every branch (f, or MCSF_UNKNOWN only when f is MCSF_UNKNOWN), so the final if changes nothing.
findings.evidence: Read mc_save_formats.c:932-954. The only callers (dash_card_tool.c:718, tests/mc_save_formats_host.c:71, :101) read format after the call; it is unchanged by lines 951-952.
